# Parameter reference

<!-- generated by tools/gen_param_ref.sh from firmware/src/sy_param.c: do not edit by hand -->

Every parameter a Strata sound stores, by section, as the screen shows it. **Mod**: the matrix (and the
assign window) can move it. **CC**: the MIDI control change that sets it without MIDI LEARN (none: -).
The drums, the looper and the settings keep their own values: see their chapters.
